\subsection{The OpenAlex Snapshot of 10 November 2026}\label{supp:snapshot}

Every OpenAlex number of Section~\ref*{P-sec:reach} of the paper and of Section~\ref{supp:openalexq} comes from the raw JSON responses of one snapshot, taken by \texttt{scripts/openalex\_snapshot.py} on 10 November 2026 between 15:52:35 and 15:52:44 UTC. Table~\ref{supp:snapfiles} lists its files and Table~\ref{supp:snapurls} the time and URL of each request. The API key used for the requests is not in any file.
